one_liner: Modern, flexible CRM with a customizable data model and REST API.

auth.evidence_quote: Attio implements the standard OAuth 2.0 specification.
auth.notes: Single-workspace access tokens ('API keys' in Attio's UI, generated under Workspace Settings > Developers) are workspace-scoped bearer tokens; OAuth 2.0 is the path for apps connecting to other workspaces.

access.evidence_quote: If you only need a token for a single workspace, you can generate an API key in the developer settings page of your apps.
access.notes: Attio offers a free workspace signup allowing immediate API key generation; did not independently confirm pricing-plan gating on API access within call budget.

api.notes: Did not check for an official/community Attio MCP server within the 4-call budget.

verdict.rationale: Free workspace signup with immediate API-key access plus OAuth 2.0 support for third-party integrations.
